SOC 31-9092

Medical Assistants by metro

Among Austin, Chicago, and Seattle, Medical Assistants have a published OEWS May 2025 annual median of $61,500 in Seattle, the highest in this slice. Published medians: Seattle $61,500, Chicago $47,270, Austin $45,820.

Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. bls.gov/oes. These figures are informational republications of BLS OEWS. They are not legal, career, or hiring advice.
